title: What If an Elevator Fell 75 Floors? A Woman Survived One

scenes.text: What if an elevator fell seventy-five floors? Somebody lived to tell about it.
On July 28, 1945, a bomber hit the Empire State Building in fog. The crash cut the cables of an elevator.
Operator Betty Lou Oliver was inside as the cab dropped about 300 meters, roughly 1,000 feet, to the basement.
Air trapped in the nearly sealed shaft acted like a cushion and slowed the fall.
At the bottom, the snapped cables piled into a coil that worked like a giant spring.
She broke her neck, back and pelvis but survived. Guinness still lists it as the longest fall survived in an elevator.

description:
What if an elevator fell seventy-five floors?
In 1945 it happened at the Empire State Building, and the operator survived thanks to trapped air and coiled cables.
